I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that the date for the sheet is **10 June**, not 25 November.

- **Why:** Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team on 14 Oct. Later that day she corrected it in #north-random to 10 June, saying she'd "read the wrong line."
- **Marcus can see it:** he's a member of both #north-team and #north-random, so the correction is something he could read himself. A renewal date is an account fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the North team.
- **Old date still up:** I pointed out that Ilse's 25 November post in #north-team hasn't been edited, so anyone reading there could still pick up the old date.

The knowledge base (gbrain) refused my search: its connection isn't set to any one member, so nothing came back. Whoever runs the gbrain server would need to fix that before it can be used. I used only the channels Marcus belongs to (#north-team, #north-random and #general, which had nothing on this). I didn't use the cross-channel message search.
